featured_reviews.name: gautam mali
featured_reviews.review_text:
_*Exceptional Care and Unwavering Support: A Review for Dr. Neha Patel [Gynecologist]*_ 🙏🙏

​We are writing this review to express our profound gratitude for the phenomenal care provided by Dr. Neha Patel during my wife's entire pregnancy journey. Her expertise and compassionate approach made a potentially stressful time incredibly reassuring.
​Pushpa clinic, though minimal in staff , provided good care throughout my wife's entire 9-month pregnancy journey.
​The Doctor is simply outstanding. Her personalized attention and dedication made all the difference. From our very first visit to the final stages of delivery, she was consistently thorough, reassuring, and incredibly knowledgeable. She handled all our concerns with patience and ensured that every check-up and procedure was smooth and comfortable.
​Knowing that the doctor was personally overseeing my wife's health for the full nine months and beyond gave us immense peace of mind.
​If you are looking for personalized and excellent care where you are treated like a priority, this is the clinic to choose. We are so grateful for the wonderful experience!

featured_reviews.name: Desiree Gamble
featured_reviews.review_text:
When i shifted to Naigaon east, i never knew anyone and one fine day when I fell sick and consulted Dr. Neha, that day was the biggest blessing in my life. I had conceived and from that day my pregnancy under her care, guidance and supervision was such a wonderful experience that today me and my Baby are safe and healthy.
Everything was explained in detail. If I had doubts, Dr. Neha would explain so well that I experienced the Love that no other doctor would give. So polite and humble. Always smiling (this is the best part, every doctor usually does not smile😁) I was so comfortable like a family member.
Dr. Neha and Dr. Vikas, both have taken care of me and baby so well that I will always go to them only when needed and share my experience with all pregnant women and suggest them to consult them. A big thank you and God bless ☺️🙏💐🥰👍

We visited at Dr. Rajendra Pingle’s Naigon Hospital in Feb 2021. Without unnecessary medicine ,test & reports he diagnosed and give treatment in such a perfect way that we get good news in April2021. We decided to walk our pregnancy journey with him for next 9 month. During every check up visit he guided us wonderfully for smooth and safe delivery. He is responding very nicely on phone and whattup for our every little query  even in midnight.
In 1st Jan 2022 we blessed with healthy baby boy at his hospital.
Words are less to thank Dr. Rajendra for bringing wonderful tiny little pumpkin in our life .I wish he had met earlier .
I trust him more than our reports .He is one of the most experience , compassionate and intelligent doctor with humanity and ethical practitioner , very rare to find this days..
Excellent is less to define him ,special thanks to your swift decisions and analysis of situation and exemplary services .
I must say Hospital is neat , clean, and budget friendly also staff is really polite , kind and very supportive like family members .
We would highly recommend to each one who is going through stressful situation for pregnancy and looking for genuine doctor in town.
